Mumbai: Banks lose their gold import tax break -- Revenue Secretary confirms 3% IGST since April.

મુંબઈ: બેંકોએ સોનાની આયાત પરની કર રાહત ગુમાવી -- એપ્રિલથી 3% IGST લાગુ.

Arvind Shrivastava says the exemption list for banks and nominated agencies was not renewed past 31 March, so the 3% IGST other routes already pay now applies too.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
